name: Neil Armstrong
summary: First person to walk on the Moon: 'That's one small step for [a] man, one giant leap for mankind.'

name: Buzz Aldrin
summary: Second person on the Moon.

name: Pete Conrad
summary: Third moonwalker; visited the Surveyor 3 probe.

name: Alan Bean
summary: Fourth moonwalker and later a painter of lunar scenes.

name: Alan Shepard
summary: First American in space (1961) and the only one to golf on the Moon.

name: Edgar Mitchell
summary: Sixth moonwalker.

name: David Scott
summary: First to drive the Lunar Roving Vehicle; dropped a hammer and feather to test Galileo.

name: James Irwin
summary: Found the 'Genesis Rock'.

name: John Young
summary: Later commanded the first Space Shuttle flight.

name: Charles Duke
summary: Youngest moonwalker (36); left a family photo on the Moon.

name: Eugene Cernan
summary: The last person to walk on the Moon (so far).

name: Harrison Schmitt
summary: The only geologist and scientist to walk on the Moon.

name: Yuri Gagarin
summary: First human in space, orbiting Earth once in 108 minutes.

name: Valentina Tereshkova
summary: First woman in space.

name: Alexei Leonov
summary: First spacewalk.

name: John Glenn
summary: First American to orbit Earth; flew again at 77.

name: Sally Ride
summary: First American woman in space.

name: Svetlana Savitskaya
summary: First woman to spacewalk.

name: Valeri Polyakov
summary: Record single spaceflight: 437 days.

name: Yang Liwei
summary: China's first astronaut.

name: Peggy Whitson
summary: American record holder for total time in space (over 675 days).

name: Oleg Kononenko
summary: First person to log over 1,000 days in space.

name: Christina Koch
summary: First woman to fly around the Moon.

name: Victor Glover
summary: First person of colour to travel around the Moon.

name: Jeremy Hansen
summary: First non-American to fly around the Moon.

name: Reid Wiseman
summary: Commander of Artemis II.

name: Rakesh Sharma
summary: First Indian in space: 'Saare Jahan Se Achha'.

name: Kalpana Chawla
summary: First woman of Indian origin in space; died in the Columbia disaster (2003).

name: Sunita Williams
summary: Spent ~9 months on the ISS in 2024–25 after Starliner's problems.

name: Shubhanshu Shukla
summary: First Indian to visit the ISS (June–July 2025), a step toward Gaganyaan.

name: Fruit flies (1947)
summary: The first animals in space, launched to study radiation; recovered alive.

name: Albert II
summary: First monkey (and primate) in space; died on impact.

name: Laika
summary: First animal to orbit Earth; died of overheating within hours.

name: Belka and Strelka
summary: Dogs that orbited Earth and returned alive.

name: Ham the chimp
summary: First great ape in space; survived.

name: Félicette
summary: The only cat to go to space and return alive.

name: Zond 5 tortoises
summary: First animals to fly around the Moon and return.

name: Arabella and Anita
summary: Spiders that learned to spin webs in microgravity.

name: Tardigrades (FOTON-M3)
summary: Survived exposure to open space vacuum and radiation.

name: Mice on the ISS
summary: Mice studied for muscle and bone loss in microgravity.

name: Medaka fish
summary: First vertebrates to mate in orbit.

name: Jellyfish (STS-40)
summary: Thousands of jellyfish flown to study gravity sensing.
